blocks.text: Helpbox carries the idea of bringing several useful things to a difficult moment. Its folding compartments condense the larger work of preparation into an ordinary portable object, without making it a cure for every condition.
A small folding care box. Lift the lid to deploy its repair pads.
One-shot use: The lid flips off, the side panels unfold, and the repair pads rise visibly out of the box. The game performs the final fade.

38 silver. Injury / Chronic severity −2; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +16; Energy +3. Health +4 more if Chronic remains after treatment. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
